title: Apache and nginx Settings
subtitle: Security headers and custom directives. Saving re-renders the nginx vhost.

php-fpm.name: nginx + PHP-FPM
php-fpm.description: Default. nginx calls PHP-FPM directly through FastCGI. Ideal for WordPress, Laravel, and dynamic PHP sites with the lowest latency.

apache.name: nginx + Apache
apache.description: nginx terminates TLS at the edge, while Apache (10080) serves the vhost behind it. Full .htaccess support for Joomla, older WordPress sites, and legacy CMSs.

static.name: Static (no PHP)
static.description: Serves files only. Intended for React, Vue, or Angular SPAs, static site generators such as Hugo and Jekyll, and CDN content. PHP requests return 404.

headers.hdr_x_content_type: Prevents MIME sniffing as an XSS defense
headers.hdr_permissions: Disables camera, microphone, and location APIs by default
headers.hdr_csp_upgrade: Automatically upgrades HTTP links to HTTPS

stack.title: Web Server Stack
stack.description: nginx remains the TLS terminator at the edge. The selection below routes the domain to the chosen backend engine.

docRoot.title: Document Root
docRoot.description: Choose which public_html subdirectory nginx serves. Laravel applications usually use the public directory.

hsts.description: Browsers connect to the site only over HTTPS. Incorrect configuration is difficult to reverse, so enable it only when appropriate.
hsts.includeSubDomainsDesc: Apply to all subdomains after confirming that each one supports HTTPS
hsts.preloadDesc: Include the site in browsers by default (registration at hstspreload.org is required)

cache.fastcgiDesc: Caches WordPress and PHP pages on disk. POST requests, cookies, login pages, and previews are skipped automatically. Resolves the WP Site Health page-cache warning.
cache.browserDesc: Static files such as CSS, JS, PNG, JPG, and WOFF are cached in the browser, making repeat visits load much faster.
